notDeployed.market: Retained custom-market prototype for local/devnet lifecycle tooling. Mainnet trading runs on the Manifest fork, so this program is not part of the mainnet deploy set or its rent budget.

releaseGates: MagicBlock fee-vault exit deployment (exit proven on devnet 2026-09-12; mainnet needs its own deployment)
notes: This file deliberately contains no invented deployment addresses. A Mainnet build may render issuer metadata, but runtime checks keep trading unavailable until the programs and MagicBlock endpoint are explicitly configured and verified.
